Analysis: Foundation analysis, seismic analysis, wind analysis, superstructure analysis.

d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.

As Private Label Manager, you’ll play a key role in building and growing Calo’s private label portfolio across Marketplace and retail channels. You’ll turn customer and market insights into commercially successful products, managing the journey from idea to launch while balancing quality, cost, and customer value. This role is central to expanding our product offering, driving profitable growth, and building strong supplier partnerships.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Food Science, Supply Chain, or a related field.
4–7 years of experience in Private Label, Category Management, Product Management, Buying, FMCG, Retail, or Food Manufacturing.
Proven experience taking consumer products from concept through commercialization.
Strong commercial and analytical mindset, with experience managing product P&Ls or category performance.
Experience working with manufacturers, suppliers, and contract producers.
Strong understanding of food product development, packaging, labeling, and regulatory requirements.
Excellent project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple launches simultaneously.
Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; experience with BI tools is a plus.
